target.title: fix(gateway): redact Responses media blocks in chat history sanitization
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users viewing chat history in Control UI / WebChat would still receive embedded `data:` image payloads on Responses-style media blocks (`input_image.image_url` and legacy `image.url`) after history sanitization, even though other base64 and data-URL media paths were already redacted.

## Why This Change Was Made

`sanitizeChatHistoryContentBlock()` now treats Responses media blocks the same as existing image/audio redaction: data URLs are removed from the projected history payload, replaced with `omitted: true` plus a byte count, while non-`data:` http(s) URLs remain intact for display/linking.

## User Impact

Chat history fetched through the gateway no longer leaks inline base64 image data for WebChat Responses `input_image` blocks or data-URL `image.url` blocks. Operators and users still see that media was present (via `omitted` + `bytes`) without shipping the raw payload over the wire. Remote https image links continue to display normally.

## Evidence

### Unit tests

```text
OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/gateway/server-methods/server-methods.test.ts -t "sanitizeChatHistoryMessages"
# 8 passed | 157 skipped (165)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/chat-sanitize.test.ts
# 44 passed (4 files)
```

New cases in `server-methods.test.ts`:
- redacts WebChat Responses `input_image` data URLs
- redacts existing `image.url` data URLs (regression guard)
- preserves non-data `https://` image URLs

### Lint

```text
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
  src/gateway/chat-display-projection.ts \
  src/gateway/server-methods/server-methods.test.ts \
  scripts/proof-chat-history-sanitize-input-image.mjs
```

### Real behavior proof (outside Vitest)

```text
node --import tsx scripts/proof-chat-history-sanitize-input-image.mjs
```

## Real behavior proof

Environment: Node v24.13.1, win32/x64, branch `fix/chat-history-sanitize-input-image`, commit `a17373a1b4` (rebased on `origin/main`).

Proof script imports production `sanitizeChatHistoryMessages()` from `src/gateway/chat-display-projection.ts` and feeds realistic message payloads:

| Case | Input | Expected | Result |
|------|-------|----------|--------|
| 1 | `input_image.image_url = data:image/png;base64,...` | `omitted=true`, `bytes` set, URL removed | PASS |
| 2 | `image.url = data:image/png;base64,...` (+ text sibling) | same redaction; text preserved | PASS |
| 3 | `image.url = https://example.test/photo.png` | URL preserved, not omitted | PASS |
| 4 | `input_image.image_url = https://cdn.example.test/...` | URL preserved, not omitted | PASS |

Captured output:

```text
[proof] chat history sanitize — Responses media data URLs
  node=v24.13.1 platform=win32 arch=x64
  import=.../src/gateway/chat-display-projection.ts

  ok: input_image block type preserved
  ok: input_image omitted=true
  ok: input_image bytes=66
  ok: input_image data URL field removed
  ok: input_image no data: prefix in JSON
  ok: companion text preserved
  ok: image block type preserved
  ok: image.url omitted=true
  ok: image.url bytes=62
  ok: image.url data URL field removed
  ok: image.url no data: prefix in JSON
  ok: https image.url preserved
  ok: https image.url not omitted
  ok: https image.url has no bytes field
  ok: https input_image.image_url preserved
  ok: https input_image not omitted
  ok: https input_image has no bytes field

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS PASSED
```
